name: thought2build-v1-harness
purpose: Executable red/green contract for building Thought2Build V1 with agentic coding tasks.

commands.frontend: cd frontend && pnpm vitest run --root .. harness/tests/frontend
commands.schemas: for f in harness/schemas/*.schema.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done

test_groups.proves: The monorepo, backend, frontend, docker, and environment skeleton match the V1 plan.
FastAPI app factory, health, data models, routers, stage lifecycle, credits, security, evals, and export behavior match the spec.
The post-audit security fixes block Zip Slip exports, bound refine inputs, validate selected text, trust proxy headers safely, emit security headers, and keep dev datastores off public interfaces.
Strict TypeScript contracts, auth token handling, API client refresh, stores, and workspace UI state match the spec.
Phase 12 provider-agnostic LLM cost controls: capability registry, tier routing, prompt reuse, normalized telemetry, cache keys, and explicit cross-provider fallback.
Phase 13 GitHub export integration: ORM models, Fernet token storage, GitHubAPIClient typed exceptions, task parser purity, export orchestrator, router error mapping, rate-limit tier, and CI wiring.

Phase 13 frontend layer: TypeScript interfaces, api.ts GitHub functions (404 safety), Settings page route, ExportGitHubModal four-phase UI, workspace header GitHub button, and index.css design-system classes.

Phase 14 V1.3 usefulness improvements (backend): two new migrations (workspace v1.3 fields + templates table), Workspace + Template ORM models, Spec Clarification judge-model service with sanitisation and best-effort timeout, task Priority/Estimate enforcement in the tasks prompt + online eval, WeasyPrint PDF export service with no-network resource fetcher, public share service with CSPRNG slug generation and unambiguous alphabet, unauthenticated /public/{slug} router with allow-list response shape and noindex headers, unauthenticated /templates router backed by an idempotent seed script, harness coverage figure surfaced on the workspace response, and preservation of the pre-existing ZIP / GitHub export paths and the gap_patch_used regen gate.

Phase 14 V1.3 usefulness improvements (frontend): api.ts adds the eight v1.3 client functions without removing prior exports, SpecClarificationModal with Skip / Use-answers paths wired into Workspace, parseEffortSummary helper with graceful null on missing block plus workspace header chip, ExportPDFButton triggering a real browser download, SharePublicLinkModal with copy/toggle/rotate controls plus PublicWorkspaceView at /p/:slug outside the auth guard with noindex meta and no authenticated-store imports, robots.txt Disallow /p/, TemplatesStrip on Dashboard and the workspace creation form with template_slug provenance, harness-coverage chip rendered in workspace header / dashboard card / public view, plus the design-system CSS classes for each component.

Phase 15 Enterprise Production Hardening (T-174 through T-195): SELECT FOR UPDATE wiring, OAuth atomic getdel, PDF thread-pool dispatch, Redis connection pooling, N+1 batch query, recovery lock TTL, auth cache invalidation, httpx timeouts, coverage label fix, rate limit bulk eviction, CSRF nonce, STAGE_DEPENDENCIES single definition, Docker port binding, LLM instance cache cap, CSRF exempt path audit, CSP for public share, SSE/PDF/eval Prometheus metrics, concurrency test suite.

Phase 16 Final Remediation & Enterprise Hardening (T-196 through T-216): CF-1 SELECT FOR UPDATE wired in finalise() with integration test + misleading mock deleted, CF-2 can_route() enforced in gateway + circuit counter, HF-1 batched coverage query, HF-2 OpenAI empty-choices guard, HF-3 continuous recovery heartbeat, HF-4 get_running_loop() + dedicated PDF executor, HF-5 rate limit lazy Redis, HF-6 CSRF SETNX nonce tracking, HF-7 CI real DB service + alembic, MF-1 eval orphan task cancel, MF-2 coverage_utils shared module, MF-3 refund savepoint, MF-4 ErrorBoundary for TemplatesStrip, MF-5 Langfuse image pinned, LF-1 auth cache documented, LF-2 dedicated PDF executor, LF-3 false-confidence test deleted, LF-4 eval_results composite index migration, T-215 circuit rejection counter, T-216 RUNBOOK.md operational procedures.

Phase 23 Storyboard Product Keynote Generation (backend): Storyboard model and migration, authenticated owner router, public /storyboards/public routes, source builder, strict six-act prompt/schema, idempotent 25-credit generation and 5-credit section regeneration, refund and stale propagation, trusted renderer/downloads, permission-filtered public sharing, rate limits, observability, unit-test coverage, docs, smoke, and release-gate requirements.

Phase 23 Storyboard Product Keynote Generation (frontend): typed API surface, Storyboard types, authenticated /storyboards/:id route, unauthenticated /sb/:slug route, workspace Create/Open Storyboard flow, paid confirmation modal, toolbar, full-screen deck, architecture reveal, presenter mode, source layer, sharing permissions, downloads, launch page, public privacy, and focused component tests.

Phase 23 Storyboard JSON contracts: exactly six keynote acts, architecture reveal diagram, source map, speaker notes, demo script, technical appendix, visual identity, bounded source excerpts, and permission-filtered public response allow-list.
The core workspace pipeline can be completed through the browser once services are running.

agent_rules: Do not skip or reorder stages: SPEC -> PLAN -> HARNESS -> TASKS.
Every implementation task must name at least one harness test that turns green.
Prefer adding production code over weakening harness tests.
If a harness expectation conflicts with a newer spec decision, update the manifest and test together.
